title: Boundary Disintegration for Weighted Residual Energy Trees
summary: We study iterated weighted residual (WR) splittings generated by a positive operator $R_{0}\in B\left(H\right)_{+}$ and a finite family of contractions $C_{1},\dots,C_{m}$ in $B\left(H\right)$. The associated residual update $R\mapsto R^{1/2}(I-C^{*}_{j}C_{j})R^{1/2}$ produces an $m$-ary energy tree of residuals $\left\{ R_{w}\right\} $ and dissipated pieces $\left\{ D_{w,j}\right\} $ indexed by finite words.
